qualification.education_qualification: Coaches: NIS diploma (1 year) with B.P.Ed/M.P.Ed and 3 years' coaching experience, or B.P.Ed/M.P.Ed with national medal or state-level participation and 3 years' experience; Wrestling: listed titles/awards or state participation with 3 years' experience; Rugby: B.P.Ed/M.P.Ed/Rugby diploma or World Rugby exam, international senior player, 3 years' experience; Rector: B.P.Ed/M.P.Ed preferred.

salary_details.pay_scale: Monthly consolidated honorarium: Rs. 35,000 for Chief Sports Coaches and Rugby Sports Coach; Rs. 25,000 for Assistant Coaches and Rectors.

how_to_apply: Get the prescribed application form from www.zpkolhapur.gov.in.
Fill in the correspondence address with a nearby landmark, mobile number and own email ID.
Paste a recent photo attested by a Gazetted Officer / Special Executive Officer / Headmaster / Principal.
Attach attested true copies of all required documents and the small family declaration.
Write the post / sport applied for on the envelope.
Submit in person or by post to the Education Officer (Primary), Education Department, Zilla Parishad Kolhapur, 24-11-2026 to 08-12-2026, 11.00 to 4.00, holidays included.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely contract appointment on honorarium for 11 months No permanent appointment or regular service benefits under any circumstances Agreement on Rs. 500 stamp paper by the selected candidate Appointment may be cancelled without reason or notice if work is unsatisfactory One month's notice or one month's honorarium to leave; join within seven days of the appointment order Extension after the period is at the office's discretion

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ZP Kolhapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for ZP Kolhapur Recruitment 2026?

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Coaches: NIS diploma (1 year) with B.P.Ed/M.P.Ed and 3 years' coaching experience, or B.P.Ed/M.P.Ed with national medal or state-level participation and 3 years' experience; Wrestling: listed titles/awards or state participation with 3 years' experience; Rugby: B.P.Ed/M.P.Ed/Rugby diploma or World Rugby exam, international senior player, 3 years' experience; Rector: B.P.Ed/M.P.Ed preferred. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q5. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Knowledge of Marathi is required. Sports coaches must attend daily 06.00 to 9.00 morning and 4.00 to 7.00 evening, and as needed for competition practice. Sports coaches must work during holidays too. Selected coaches and rectors must stay residentially.

faq.question: Q6. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications with incomplete or incorrect information will not be considered. Applications without attested copies of documents will be held ineligible. Candidates bringing political or other pressure or recommendation will be disqualified. More than two living children with children born on or after 28 March 2005 makes the candidate ineligible (small family declaration).

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: List of eligible candidates will be published on the notice board of Zilla Parishad Kolhapur. No allowance is paid for attending a written or oral interview. An admit card format (Pravesh Patra 2026, non-transferable) with attested photo is part of the form.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely contract appointment on honorarium for 11 months. No permanent appointment or regular service benefits under any circumstances. Agreement on Rs. 500 stamp paper by the selected candidate.
